steps.name: brew tea
steps.note: Tea is infused and strained before the milk goes in.
Stirred into the tea in a set ratio, as in Burmese laphet yay.

sources.text: That tea is infused and strained, and that Burmese milk tea is sweetened with condensed milk; Hong Kong-style milk tea is finished with evaporated milk instead, and no times or temperatures are given.
